]

valid = schedule_sum == total_to_pay

calendar_valid = months_between <= 1

print(f"schedule_sum: {schedule_sum}")
print(f"total_to_pay: {total_to_pay}")
print(f"valid: {valid}")
print(f"calendar_valid: {calendar_valid}")
print(f"entry_count: {len(schedule)}")
"}
